The Song of Sparrows (2008), originally titled Âvâz-e Gonjeshk-hâ, is a critically acclaimed Iranian drama directed by Majid Majidi.

The film follows Karim (Reza Naji), a hardworking man employed at an ostrich farm whose life changes after an ostrich escapes. Already struggling financially, Karim is also desperate to replace his eldest daughter’s broken hearing aid.

He travels to Tehran and starts working as a motorcycle taxi driver, carrying people and delivering goods around the busy city. At first, the job gives him a chance to improve his family’s situation, but life in Tehran slowly exposes him to a world of consumerism and temptation that clashes with his simple, generous nature.

Majidi tells the story with warmth and humor, using Karim’s journey to explore family, money, dignity and how easily people can change when circumstances push them in a different direction.
